module.name: prompt
module.purpose: Loads, validates, injects, and renders named prompt templates and reusable prompt modules, including mandatory workflow_call_summary instructions, earlier-chunk fact recaps, and optional cursor-return guidance for tool-call summaries.

childModules.name: module
childModules.purpose: Defines reusable prompt fragments embedded into rendered templates: RepeatInvocation warns that an identical tool call was already requested, and PreChunk notes that the listed facts came from earlier chunks of the same tool output so only new facts should be stated.

childModules.name: template
childModules.purpose: Defines System, WorkflowPolicy, ToolCallSummarize, and ToolCallSummarizeWithCursor resources; both summarize resources open with an optional pre_chunk block, fence the tool output in a triple-backtick code block, and require a JSON summary, while only the WithCursor variant asks for a continuation cursor and the plain variant states that no further chunks follow.
